name: Questie
description: Puts quest givers, objectives and turn-ins back on the map and minimap. The 3.3.5a backport; the client itself has no quest tracking beyond the objective text.

name: Immersion
description: Replaces the quest and gossip windows with a full-screen, voice-over style dialogue frame. Backported from the retail addon.

name: ElvUI
description: Complete replacement for the default interface: unit frames, action bars, bags, chat and nameplates in one configurable package.

name: Dominos
description: Action bar replacement. Move, resize, page and hide any bar; the Bartender alternative for 3.3.5a.

name: OmniCC
description: Draws the remaining cooldown as text on every button, item and buff icon.

name: WeakAuras 2
description: Custom visual and audio alerts for buffs, debuffs, cooldowns and boss timers. The 3.3.5a backport of WeakAuras 2.

name: Skada
description: Damage, healing and threat meter. Lighter on memory than Recount and still actively maintained for WotLK.

name: Deadly Boss Mods
description: Boss timers, warnings and range checks for every WotLK raid and dungeon, plus the Classic and Burning Crusade instances.

name: Grid2
description: Compact raid frames built around status indicators, for healing a 25-man without hunting for the debuff.

name: AtlasLoot
description: Browse the full loot table of every boss, faction and crafting profession without leaving the game.

name: Auctionator
description: Rewrites the auction house into a search-and-post workflow with remembered prices. A 3.3.5a fork of Auctionator 2.9.9.

name: CartoMapper
description: World map and minimap overhaul: coordinates, zoom, instance entrances and a searchable map list.
